`stock_report.py` now flags an item as `REORDER` when what's on hand is less than 6 days of average sales. `LEAD_TIME_DAYS = 6` sits at the top of the file for when you switch suppliers.

Running it on your current `inventory.csv` gives:

```
SKU      ITEM                       ON HAND  STATUS
CF-1K    House blend 1kg                  9  REORDER
CF-250   Colombia beans 250g             42  ok
FL-100   Paper filters x100               0  OUT
MG-12    Enamel mug                      18  ok
OT-1L    Oat milk 1L                     30  REORDER
TE-50    Breakfast tea x50               25  ok
```

House blend (9 on hand, needs about 14 to cover 6 days) and oat milk (30 on hand, needs 45) are the two new flags. `OUT` still shows for anything at zero.

- **Exact boundary:** an item with exactly 6 days of stock shows `ok`, since an order placed that day arrives just as the last one sells. If you'd rather have a cushion, bump the number up to 7 or 8.
- **Stock already on order:** the report doesn't know about orders in transit, so an item stays `REORDER` every night until the delivery is counted into `on_hand`.
